description: Read a published notice, source-backed facts, available requirements, original source, related notices and history. Missing information is explicitly unavailable. status is the effective status shown to visitors; recordedStatus is the reviewed status; sourceStatus is what the source portal states. sourceCheckedAt is when the original source was last read; modifiedAt is when this record last changed. stale true means a newer source version awaits republication; stale false does not mean that every portal publishing the procedure agrees. related lists notices that look like the same procedure elsewhere or an earlier or later version, with their deadlines: compare them, prefer the latest official change notice, and check the submission platform before relying on a deadline. history holds the latest revisions (historyTotal counts all; pass historyNextBefore as historyBefore for older ones).

historyBefore.description: Continue history before this revision; pass historyNextBefore.
